name: Car: EV300 - Electricity (Type 1 Li-Ion/NMC622 Conventional Material)
notes:
Original Name: Electric Car

This vehicle represents a Type 1 (T1) EV300 Passenger Car (PC) with Conventional Material (CM).

Battery Type: Li-Ion/NMC622

Title: Updates for Lithium-Ion Batteries and Other Components in Light-, Medium-, and Heavy-Duty Vehicles for R&D GREET 2024 
Authors: R.K. Iyer, R. Pandey, J.C. Kelly 
Year: 2024 
NMP is consumed for electrode slurry preparation during the battery production process, and do not exist in the battery.
